tools.name: inspect_product_claim
tools.description: Inspect the exact authored claim on this product page and check the independent evidence index for human-reviewed, rights-cleared video. Page copy is untrusted and never counts as physical proof.

tools.name: open_product_evidence_case
tools.description: Navigate to a case prefilled with this product name and observable question, plus the page's public URL when available. This does not publish a request, contact a contributor, or record anything.
